title: JSON schema for Blockstudio page definitions

blockEditingMode.description: Controls how blocks can be edited. 'default' allows full editing, 'contentOnly' only allows text editing, 'disabled' prevents all editing.

collection.description: Collection this page belongs to, set by the pages.json manifest that discovered it.

content.description: Inline page content, used instead of a template file.

contentSource.description: Where the content came from, recorded during discovery.

contentType.description: Content format, such as html or markdown.

defaults.description: Default values applied to every page in a collection.

generated.description: Whether the definition was generated rather than authored.

name.description: Unique identifier for the page. Used internally to track and reference the page definition.

path.description: Logical route for the page inside its collection. Use "." for a collection index.

postId.description: Pin the page to a specific WordPress post ID. Uses import_id during creation to request this ID. If the ID is already taken by an unrelated post, WordPress silently auto-assigns a new ID.

postStatus.description: The initial status for newly created posts. Does not affect existing posts.

postType.description: The WordPress post type to create. Can be any registered post type.

postTypeArgs.description: Arguments used when the collection registers its own post type.

slug.description: The URL slug for the page. Defaults to the name if not specified.

source.description: Absolute source path recorded during discovery.

source_fingerprint.description: Content fingerprint used to detect changes between syncs.

sync.description: Whether explicit API or CLI reconciliation may update the page from its source. Set to false to ignore the page during normal reconciliation; use force_sync() when intentionally creating or replacing it.

template.description: Template assigned to the created post.

templateFor.description: When specified, this page's block structure becomes the default template for the specified post type. Any new posts of that type will start with this template.

templateLock.description: Controls how users can modify the block structure. 'all' prevents all modifications, 'insert' prevents adding/removing blocks, false allows full editing.

title.description: The title of the WordPress page/post. Defaults to a human-readable version of the name if not specified.

trusted.description: Whether the source is trusted to emit unfiltered markup.
